title: Blackspire Prism (Polished)
summary: Not released: Hate B zone augment preview at the unchanged0.5% rate.
body:
Historical candidate values: this earlier Hate B preview is superseded by the November 6 augment audit. Neither candidate is released; use the new preview for proposed chances, specialties and icons.

Not released: Polished augment from Hate B. Its family has a0.5% chance per regular combat kill, followed by the60/30/8/2 quality roll.

Required level: 50. Fits type-22 sockets in eligible head, arms, hands, chest, legs and feet armor. Tradeable, with no merchant resale. Existing zone forging and heroic headroom apply.
